text: Hanewer... The Is = 1073 lb. avord. i 112 lbs = 1 centrer; and 20 lbs, a 1 at none of her or 4 stones of wood. Also 600 los. 14 stupings a 27 comes a funny / and 320 lb. a 40 legends a 134 hands a 1last. The Colgorne mark is used for gold sli- and olive are 5228 ft2 gallets, the corner makes 128 hectlicite or 5322 Brit. busheds.
